comparison.objective: Use an insulated stick to move a live cable off a walkway without robot contact; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cable task tests remote pushing with a long tool, deformable-object management, and strict electrical-contact avoidance; candidate tests close precision tool insertion, fine rotation, counterholding, locking, and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: No robot part may touch cable or plug; all cable must clear the walkway and the plug must finish in the parking zone; candidate instead evaluates stopping dynamics and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both involve a handheld tool, but the safety constraints and physical ability are different. Missing rubric details: electrical effects and maximum stick/cable force are not modeled.
